critical_code_review_comments: Classic Tailwind grid gotcha fixed: overflow-x-auto wrappers with min-w-[Npx] descendants require min-w-0 on the grid/flex ancestor, otherwise the ancestor grows to the intrinsic content width. Applied on the ServiceDetail visual column — safer than patching each of the 6 visuals individually.

pod-cta is an <a> tag, so HTML `disabled` attribute does not apply. Current implementation uses pointer-events-none + opacity-50 + label swap ('Compose a pod first') which achieves the required behaviour. If a stricter contract is needed, consider adding `aria-disabled` and switching to a button when count===0.

ErrorBoundary + lazyRetry + `<Navigate to="/services" />` on invalid slug + wildcard `*` → `/` catch-all all cooperate to fully eliminate the empty screen class of bugs across all 11 routes tested (fresh load, refresh, back/forward).
All required data-testid attributes are present and stable for automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 green. Only real issue found was mobile horizontal overflow on service detail pages caused by DataPipeline's min-w-[560px] combined with missing min-w-0 on grid ancestor — fixed by adding min-w-0 to .lg:col-span-6 visual column and inner sticky wrapper in ServiceDetail.jsx. Backend still 7/7. Assembly ACT/DEPLOY layers correctly replaced old EXECUTE.
rca of the issue: RCA — mobile overflow at /services/data (docWidth=634 vs viewport=390): DataPipeline.jsx has an inner <div class='min-w-[560px] max-w-2xl'> inside an overflow-x-auto wrapper. In a CSS grid item, `min-width` defaults to `auto` (intrinsic content width) rather than 0, so the grid item ancestor stretched to fit the 560px child, defeating overflow-x-auto. Fix: added min-w-0 to the ServiceDetail visual column (`lg:col-span-6` and the sticky wrapper). Verified all 6 sub-pages now render at exactly 390px docWidth on mobile.
